request_details: LangChain adapter: working example using Redwood embeddings, VectorStore + RetrievalQA, both Python and JS variants.
LlamaIndex connector: sample that ingests markdown/HTML docs and exposes a queryable index with Redwood embeddings.
Vercel AI SDK: streaming assistant example for Next.js (Edge) + how to handle API key securely on edge functions.
Quickstarts: minimal repo (5-10 files) for each flow: (1) RAG on server, (2) client-streaming assistant, (3) batch embedding pipeline.
Latency/throughput targets: p95 < 700ms for short-turn chat; embeddings throughput ~200 req/min during indexing bursts.
SDK languages: JS/TypeScript priority (Vercel), Python for backend and experiments. Include curl examples for quick smoke tests.
Operational: guidance on batching, prefix caching suggestions, and token cost estimates for 10k monthly active users.
Security: sample pattern for token rotation, minimal SSO integration notes, and audit log access steps for admins.
use_case_requirements: Workload types: chat (consumer-facing agent), embeddings for KB search, occasional reranking for search results.
Model preferences: open model first; ability to route to smaller variant for cheaper responses during peak.
Fallback: automated downgrade to 7B quantized model if latency spikes or quota hits, with transparent headers for client.
Cost controls: per-route hard token caps, batching policies, guidance from Redwood Optimize would be helpful.
Compliance: need audit logs and ability to control retention window for dev/test vs prod indexes.
